Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Advanced tier.
core_concepts: Movement: questions and passives displacing elements from base positions.
Parsing: how humans and machines recover structure in real time.
key_laws: Recursion: finite rules generating infinite sentences.
